mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.user_id, e.merchant_id, e.score, e.content, e.img_urls, e.merchant_reply, e.reply_time, e.create_time, e.update_time, o.order_no FROM t_evaluation e LEFT JOIN t_order o ON e.order_id = o.id WHERE e.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC

SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.user_id, e.merchant_id, e.score, e.content, e.img_urls, e.merchant_reply, e.reply_time, e.create_time, e.update_time, o.order_no FROM t_evaluation e LEFT JOIN t_order o ON e.order_id = o.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.user_id, e.merchant_id, e.score, e.content, e.img_urls, e.merchant_reply, e.reply_time, e.create_time, e.update_time, o.order_no FROM t_evaluation e LEFT JOIN t_order o ON e.order_id = o.id WHERE e.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.user_id, e.score, e.content, e.img_urls, e.merchant_reply, e.reply_time, e.create_time, e.update_time, u.nickname as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar, o.order_no FROM t_evaluation e LEFT JOIN t_user u ON e.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_order o ON e.order_id = o.id WHERE e.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_evaluation SET merchant_reply = #{merchantReply}, reply_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{evaluationId} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
UPDATE t_evaluation SET merchant_reply = NULL, reply_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{evaluationId} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_evaluation (order_id, user_id, merchant_id, score, content, img_urls, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{imgUrls}, NOW(), NOW())
